Hey there! I'll show you how to use this sprite and give you some tips!

Delay is the amount of time (in seconds) it waits until switching to the next costume, so you can make the animation go faster or slower.

The amount of costumes is, well, the amount of costumes your pose has, so feel free to add as many costumes as you like.

The key should always match what key you use for it, otherwise the hold notes won't work.

The "Tick" broadcast allows BF to do things while in his poses. For example, you can make him change color continuously, or make him shake a bit.

DO NOT DELETE DUPLICATED SCRIPTS! This allows spamming.

And that's pretty much all I have to say. Have fun! Oh, I almost forgot, please give credit to @Inker275!
